title: The first caliphates
blurb: Within a century, Muslim rule stretches from Spain to the Indus. Persia falls, Byzantium shrinks, the Quran is standardised.

events.title: Abu Bakr, first caliph
events.what: Abu Bakr is chosen as the first caliph. Tribes that renounce Islam or refuse zakat are brought back in the Ridda wars.

events.title: The Quran is collected
events.what: Many memorisers die at Yamamah. Umar urges Abu Bakr to gather the Quran into one written copy. Zayd leads the work.

events.title: Umar ibn al-Khattab
events.what: Umar becomes caliph. He sets up the Hijri calendar, a treasury, stipends and courts across the new lands.

events.title: The Battle of Yarmuk
events.what: Khalid routs a far larger Byzantine army at the Yarmuk river. Syria is lost to Byzantium for good.

events.title: The Battle of Qadisiyyah
events.what: Sad defeats the Persian army at Qadisiyyah. The Sasanian capital Ctesiphon falls the next year.

events.title: Umar enters Jerusalem
events.what: Jerusalem surrenders to Umar in person. Churches are protected by a written pact. He prays outside the church to keep it Christian.

events.title: Egypt and Fustat
events.what: Amr takes Egypt from Byzantium and founds Fustat, the seed of Cairo, with the first mosque in Africa.

events.title: The end of Sasanian Persia
events.what: The last Persian army falls at Nahavand. The Sasanian empire, four centuries old, is finished.

events.title: Uthman's Quran
events.what: Caliph Uthman has master copies of the Quran made and sent to each province. Every Quran today follows this text.

events.title: Ali and the civil war
events.what: Uthman is killed by rebels. Ali becomes caliph and moves to Kufa. Civil war with Muawiyah follows at Siffin.

events.title: The Umayyads
events.what: Ali is assassinated. Muawiyah founds the Umayyad dynasty and rules from Damascus. The caliphate becomes hereditary.

events.title: The Year of Unity
events.what: Hasan, Ali's son, gives up his claim to end the bloodshed. Muslims call it the Year of Unity.

events.title: Kairouan and the Atlantic
events.what: Uqba founds Kairouan, the base for Islam in North Africa. He later rides to the Atlantic.

events.title: First siege of Constantinople
events.what: The first Muslim siege of Constantinople fails. Abu Ayyub, the Prophet's host in Madinah, is buried at its walls.

events.title: Karbala
events.what: Husayn, the Prophet's grandson, is killed with his family at Karbala by Yazid's army. Remembered every Ashura.

events.title: The Dome of the Rock
events.what: Abd al-Malik builds the Dome of the Rock, the oldest surviving Islamic monument. Arabic becomes the language of state.

events.title: Tariq crosses to Spain
events.what: Tariq crosses the strait that still bears his name and defeats the Visigoths. Muslim rule in Spain lasts 781 years.

events.title: Islam reaches the Indus
events.what: A seventeen-year-old general takes Sindh. Islam reaches the Indus.

events.title: Bukhara and Samarkand
events.what: Qutayba takes Bukhara and Samarkand. Central Asia, later home to al-Bukhari and Ibn Sina, joins the Muslim world.

events.title: Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz
events.what: Umar II rules for two years, returns wrongly taken wealth and ends abuses. Often called the fifth rightly guided caliph.

events.title: The Battle of Tours
events.what: A Muslim raid from Spain is stopped near Tours by the Franks. The Pyrenees become the frontier.

events.title: The Abbasid revolution
events.what: The Abbasids, descendants of the Prophet's uncle, overthrow the Umayyads. One prince escapes to Spain.
